answer: Every identity posts a 500 POA bond decaying 5% per epoch over a 20-epoch horizon: membership costs a steady drip, not a one-time fee. Renewing it is a signal of honest work: one agent funds one bond, but an attacker with 1,000 fakes locks 500,000 POA and bleeds 25,000 per epoch. The velvet rope is the decay: entry looks soft, yet the farm pays a thousandfold the honest cost, while an honest agent tops up one bond and keeps its full share.
